record.summary: Uruguay's national AI strategy for 2024-2030 seeks to use AI for sustainable development and inclusive growth through its ethical, responsible, safe, critical, creative and pro-innovation development and use. Its governance axis calls for risk-based regulatory frameworks, a national analysis of AI uses unacceptable for their impact on rights with possible prohibitions or moratoria, instruments to identify and mitigate risks to human rights, transparency, accountability and audit frameworks, AI security risk assessment and regulatory sandboxes. Its other axes cover capacities (infrastructure, data, cybersecurity, talent) and sustainable development, including AI in public administration.
record.notes: Approved by the Public Sector Strategic Committee for AI and Data at its session of 21 Nov 2024 and published on 22 Nov 2024 (the strategy's own page on gub.uy gives 19 Nov 2024 as its creation date), after a participatory process with contributions from more than 300 people; CAF and UNESCO gave technical cooperation. It runs from 2024 to 2030 with a mid-term review, and its implementation is subject to public monitoring and evaluation. Article 74 of Law No. 20.212 (promulgated 6 Nov 2023) tasks AGESIC with a national data and AI strategy founded on principles including equity, non-discrimination, accountability, transparency, auditing and safe innovation, acting jointly with the personal data regulator (URCDP) on personal data, and required a report with recommendations for regulating AI. IMPO records Article 74 as regulated by Decree No. 276/025 of 2 Dec 2025.
record.scope_note: A national AI strategy with three objectives (governance, capacities and sustainable development); included as Uruguay's national AI strategy, whose first objective is a governance framework for ethical, responsible and safe AI.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026: read the strategy itself, AGESIC's 'Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial del Uruguay 2024 – 2030' (59-page PDF and its page on gub.uy, stored 17 Oct 2026), on which the summary rests; re-read the AGESIC publication page (stored 11 Oct 2026, unchanged on 17 Oct 2026), which confirms the title, the publication date 22/11/2024 and the committee's approval on 21 Nov 2024; and IMPO's text of Article 74 of Law No. 20.212 (stored 11 Oct 2026; IMPO returned a near-empty page on 17 Oct 2026, so the earlier copy is kept), which gives the article's principles and the note that it is regulated by Decree No. 276/025. The IMPO text layer shows accented letters as replacement characters. No English version was found.

Generar marcos que garanticen la disponibilidad de instrumentos para identificar, evaluar, prevenir, mitigar los riesgos y abordar el impacto adverso de la aplicación de la IA en los derechos humanos
